answer: Proof-of-stake protocols require agents to stake capital to participate, ensuring that Sybil attacks cost a fortune in locked assets. If an attacker tries to wander across the network creating identities, they face proportional slashing. Like a cooling ember, their influence fades without capital backing. The violet light of transparency reveals honest nodes, while the financial threshold makes mass identity fabrication economically irrational, protecting the consensus ledger from malicious saturation.
